submitted.rationale: XRD shows the AgSbO3 pyrochlore phase (Q ≈ 1.88, 2.67, 3.09, 3.56) along the whole Ag-rich to 1:1 range. Toward the Sb-rich end an Sb-oxide secondary phase takes over (Q ≈ 2.11, 2.44, 3.45, 4.05). The near-stoichiometric Ag0.50Sb0.50 composition (index 5) gave the highest EQE I measured, 0.115%. That beats Ag-rich index 2 (0.091%) and Sb-rich, mixed-phase index 12 (0.044%), which points to a peak close to 1:1 AgSbO3.
